title: DeConSyn
summary: DeConSyn is a University of Zurich master's thesis project implementing a decentralized (federated) synthetic tabular data generation framework that trains generators across multiple agents without sharing raw data, evaluated on Adult, cardio, and churn datasets. It vendors and adapts the CTGAN package in-tree (DeConSyn/models/CTGAN, whose data_transformer.py imports rdt.transformers directly) as its core decentralized generator, and its embedded FEST evaluation framework directly instantiates sdv.single_table's GaussianCopula, CTGAN, TVAE, and CopulaGAN synthesizers as benchmarking baselines.
